content_sections.heading: SBI SO Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: SBI has published a tentative examination and interview schedule. The exact dates will be announced through the SBI Careers website. Candidates should regularly check official updates and their registered email addresses.

content_sections.heading: SBI SO Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The SBI Specialist Cadre Officer notification announces 60 vacancies for Manager (Security) and Deputy Manager (Security) in MMGS-III and MMGS-II grades respectively. Vacancy Clarification: The notification provides a combined total of 60 vacancies for Manager (Security) and Deputy Manager (Security). It does not provide separate vacancy counts for each designation. The number of vacancies is provisional and may change according to the Bank's requirements.

content_sections.heading: SBI SO Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must have completed graduation from a Government-recognized university or institution and possess the specified experience as commissioned officers in the Armed Forces or officers in paramilitary forces. The educational qualification alone does not establish eligibility. Candidates must also meet the respective service rank, experience and medical fitness requirements as on 31 October 2026. Candidates applying for Manager (Security) in MMGS-III must satisfy either of the following conditions: An officer not below the rank of Major in the Indian Army or equivalent rank in the Indian Navy or Air Force, with at least 10 years of commissioned service . An officer not below the rank of Deputy Commandant in paramilitary forces , with at least 10 years of service as an officer in the force. Candidates applying for Deputy Manager (Security) in MMGS-II must satisfy either of the following conditions: An officer not below the rank of Captain in the Indian Army or equivalent rank in the Indian Navy or Air Force, with at least 5 years of commissioned service . An officer not below the rank of Assistant Commandant in paramilitary forces , with at least 5 years of service as an officer in the force. Retired candidates must upload the relevant medical category information from their discharge book or service record. Candidates currently serving must upload their latest Medical Board document indicating their medical category. Important: SBI requires supporting documents for service experience and medical fitness during online application. Applications without the prescribed documents may not be considered for shortlisting or interview.

content_sections.heading: SBI SO Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit for Manager (Security) and Deputy Manager (Security) is 25 to 40 years as on 31 October 2026 , with applicable upper-age relaxation for eligible reserved categories. SBI states that cumulative age relaxation will not be available. Applicants claiming relaxation must produce the relevant certificates when required.

rows.details: As per Government of India Guidelines, Where Applicable

content_sections.heading: SBI SO Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The starting basic pay is Rs. 85,920 for Manager (Security) and Rs. 64,820 for Deputy Manager (Security) . Both positions are regular Specialist Cadre Officer posts. Selected officers will also be eligible for applicable Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), City Compensatory Allowance (CCA), Provident Fund, National Pension System (NPS), Leave Fare Concession, medical facilities and other benefits under SBI rules. Salary Clarification: These amounts represent basic pay scales, not guaranteed monthly in-hand salaries. Actual earnings depend on allowances, posting and applicable deductions. The probation period for Manager (Security) and Deputy Manager (Security) is six months , as specified in the recruitment notification.

content_sections.heading: SBI SO Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee is Rs. 750 for General, EWS and OBC candidates . SC and ST candidates are exempt from the fee. Payment Mode: Online through Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking or UPI. The application fee is non-refundable. Registration is completed only after successful payment of the applicable fee.

content_sections.heading: SBI SO Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of an online written examination followed by a personal interview . The final merit calculation gives 70% weightage to Professional Knowledge and 30% to the interview. Online Written Test: Candidates appear in the objective examination. Shortlisting: SBI shortlists candidates based on the examination results and applicable requirements. Personal Interview: Shortlisted candidates attend an interview carrying 100 marks. Document Verification: Educational qualifications, service experience, medical fitness and category certificates are verified. Final Merit List: Prepared using normalized Professional Knowledge and interview marks. SBI reserves the right to modify the selection process, including considering shortlisting followed by interview, if required.

content_sections.heading: SBI SO Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The online written examination contains 200 objective questions carrying 200 marks , with a total duration of two hours. Reasoning Ability, English Language and General Awareness are qualifying in nature. Marks obtained in these three qualifying sections are not counted toward final merit. Candidates must obtain the minimum qualifying marks fixed by SBI in the applicable sections. Professional Knowledge carries 100 marks and contributes to final merit. There is no negative marking for incorrect answers. If candidates have the same score at the cut-off point, SBI will rank them according to age in descending order.

content_sections.heading: SBI Security Officer Job Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Selected Manager and Deputy Manager (Security) officers will be responsible for improving security arrangements at SBI branches and offices. Conduct periodic security audits of branches and offices. Review existing security arrangements and recommend improvements. Organize security drills, lectures and employee awareness programmes. Monitor security systems and reduce incidents caused by security lapses. Support implementation of disaster management plans. Visit branches and other administrative units to assess security requirements. Coordinate with civil, military, police and other Government authorities. Perform additional security administration duties assigned by SBI. Selected officers may be posted or transferred to SBI offices anywhere in India according to the Bank's requirements.

content_sections.text: Applicants must upload documents supporting their eligibility, service experience and medical fitness. Recent passport-size colour photograph. Candidate signature. Latest Medical Board document for currently serving applicants. Applicable caste, OBC-NCL or EWS certificate. No Objection Certificate, where applicable. Other employment and supporting documents required by the official application form. The handwritten declaration must be written clearly in English using black ink on white paper. Declarations written entirely in capital letters are not accepted. Candidates must also capture a live photograph using a webcam or mobile phone during the online application process.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in SBI Recruitment 2026 for security posts?
faq.answer: SBI has advertised 60 provisional vacancies for Manager (Security) and Deputy Manager (Security) together: 9 SC, 4 ST, 16 OBC, 6 EWS and 25 UR.

faq.question: Q2. When does online registration start for SBI Manager (Security) recruitment?
faq.answer: Online registration and fee payment start on 4 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for SBI Recruitment 2026 for security posts?
faq.answer: The last date for online registration, including editing of the application, and for payment of the fee is 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for SBI Manager and Deputy Manager (Security)?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹750 for UR/EWS/OBC candidates, and SC/ST candidates pay no fee. It is paid online and is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for SBI Security Officer posts?
faq.answer: The age limit is minimum 25 years and maximum 40 years as on 31.10.2026, with relaxation in the upper age limit for reserved categories as per Govt. of India guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification and experience are required for Manager (Security)?
faq.answer: A graduate in any discipline from a Government recognized University or Institution who is an officer not below the rank of Major (or equivalent in Navy/Airforce) with minimum 10 years of commissioned service, or not below Deputy Commandant in Para-military forces with minimum 10 years of service as an officer.

faq.question: Q7. What experience is required for Deputy Manager (Security)?
faq.answer: An officer not below the rank of Captain in the Indian Army (or equivalent in Navy/Airforce) with minimum 5 years of commissioned service, or not below Assistant Commandant in Para-military forces with minimum 5 years of service as an officer, besides graduation.

faq.question: Q8. What is the pay scale for SBI Manager (Security) and Deputy Manager (Security)?
faq.answer: Manager (Security) in MMGS-III gets Rs (85920-2680/5-99320-2980/2-105820) and Deputy Manager (Security) in MMGS-II gets Rs (64820-2340/1-67160-2680/10-93960), plus DA, HRA, CCA, PF, NPS, LFC and medical facility as per rules.

faq.question: Q9. Is there negative marking in the SBI Security Officer online test?
faq.answer: No. The notice states there will be no penalty for wrong answers in the objective tests; the test has 200 questions for 200 marks in two hours.

faq.question: Q10. What medical category is needed to apply for SBI security posts?
faq.answer: Applicants must have medical fitness in SHAPE-1 or an equivalent medical category as on the date of release of the advertisement, and must upload the supporting document with the online application.
